title: HarvestFlow
description: Smart auto-replant farming with custom crop mappings and drop-safe logic.
body:
# HarvestFlow

> Smooth farming flow for survival servers: harvest fast, auto-replant instantly, stay balanced.

## ![sparkles](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2728.svg) Why It Feels Premium

- **Instant replant loop** for mature crops
- **Survival-safe cost** (always consumes a seed/payment item)
- **Custom crop mapping** for modded/custom setups that expose Bukkit materials
- **Drop-safe fallback logic** so it keeps working with many protection/drop plugins
- **Per-player toggle** for full control

---

## ![new](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f195.svg) 1.0.2 Highlights

- Added **auto-detect mode** for mature `Ageable` crops
- Added **custom seed/payment mappings** in config
- Improved **drop compatibility** and fallback payment flow
- Expanded support for newer crops like **Torchflower** and **Pitcher**

---

## ![puzzle](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f9e9.svg) Custom Crop Mapping (Config)

```yml
auto-detect-ageable-crops: true

custom-seed-mappings:
  TORCHFLOWER_CROP:
    - TORCHFLOWER_SEEDS
  PITCHER_CROP:
    - PITCHER_POD
```

---

## ![wheat](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f33e.svg) Default Supported Crops

- Wheat
- Carrots
- Potatoes
- Beetroot
- Nether Wart

---

## ![keyboard](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2328.svg) Commands

```text
/autoreplant
/autoreplant toggle
/autoreplant on
/autoreplant off
/autoreplant status
/autoreplant reload
```

## ![shield](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f6e1.svg) Permissions

```text
harvestflow.use
harvestflow.admin
```

---

## ![gear](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2699.svg) Main Config Controls

- `auto-detect-ageable-crops`
- `custom-seed-mappings`
- `supported-crops`
- `enabled-worlds`
- `require-permission`
- `actionbar-feedback`
- `notify-missing-seed`

---

## ![white_check_mark](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2705.svg) Compatibility

- Java 17+
- Paper API 1.20.4
- Loaders: Bukkit, Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Folia

---
